records.part: Replace rodder outfit only with custom fabrication (rodder truck outfit replacement, existing Isuzu NRR chassis retained)
records.reason: AWI is the only reasonably known, capable supplier to fabricate and install the rodder outfit, due to the unique nature of the WWC Division’s requirements, as well as current market conditions.

records.part: Vacuum truck (combination sewer/storm drain cleaner truck) replacement
records.reason: Of all known vendors, MME is the only company able to provide the type of vehicle that meets the City’s requirements. MME manufactures the Vac-Con, the only combination cleaner with an auxiliary engine, while all other manufacturers provided single engine units.
